title: The manifest of a bundle crossing between the evaluator and an arm host (ADR-0018 D5)
description: `MANIFEST.json` at the root of a release or result tar, written by the side that packs it: every regular file with its SHA-256 and size, and every link as data (its target text), sorted by path. Directories are implied. The bundle's hash is the SHA-256 of this file's canonical bytes; the receiving side recomputes it from what it received and refuses a mismatch (TRANSFER_CORRUPT).
